applyTo: "**"
---

File and Directory Management

    Direct Manipulation: Always use built-in tools to create, read, update, or delete files and folders directly.

    Avoid Terminal Overload: Do not use mkdir, touch, or echo > file commands in the terminal unless specifically requested for environment setup.

    Atomic Updates: When modifying existing files, provide the full updated content or use targeted "search and replace" blocks to ensure code integrity.

    Structure First: When starting a new feature, create the necessary folder hierarchy in a single step before populating files.
